newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk Berth 2 to close for 22-23 days-.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk Berth 2 to close for 22-23 days-.

text.p: Berth Two at Russia's main crude export port of Novorossisk is to close for scheduled maintenance from May 6 for 22-23 days, shipping and trading sources said on Tuesday.
Berth Two is the second largest of the crude berths at Novorossiisk and can take ships from 60-90,000 tonne deadweight.
The berth's closure in May will seriously affect exports which, so far this month, have been running at six month highs, traders said.

One trader calculated that if the exports so far in April were to continue for the rest of the month the average daily exports would be 640,000 barrels. This would compare with 501,000 in March, 538,000 in February and 633,000 barrels in January.
